lines.1: We left the school grounds, chatting about nothing in particular.
lines.2: The city we lived in was called Matsukasa.
lines.3: It took its name from the preserved battleship Matsukasa, once the flagship of the Combined Fleet.
lines.4: It sat in southeastern Kanto, at the mouth of Tokyo Bay.
lines.5: With both a US Navy base and a Self-Defense Force base, it had developed into a city with a distinctly international flavor.
lines.6: The population was around 450,000, if I remembered what the Princess said.
lines.7: Arcades, karaoke, billiards, darts, bowling, clubs--you name it...
lines.8: There was never any shortage of places to have fun.
lines.9: 「We did karaoke and billiards the other day, so that leaves...」
lines.10: 「The live show at the club isn't until the weekend.」
lines.11: Oddly enough, music was the one thing Fukahire took seriously.
lines.12: 「Then the arcade! Let's hit the arcade!」
lines.14: Quite a few Ryuumeikan Academy students were passing through Matsukasa Station on their way home.
lines.15: The arcade occupied the station building's first five floors--a full-fledged gaming plaza.
lines.17: 「Just don't trap somebody in an infinite combo and start a fight.」
lines.18: 「Guess I'll go play the guitar game.」
lines.20: Twelve hundred yen... I'd spent a fair bit.
lines.24: The three of us lived ridiculously close together.
lines.25: And with that, I went home.
